strings.Algorithme : pour chaque tranche, diffic: Algorithm: for each slice, difficulty = (deaths + 1) ÷ (passes + 2), a smoothing that keeps a single death from making a slice "impossible". Recent runs weigh more (half-life of 14 days) to follow your progress. Neighbouring slices above 2 × the level's median are merged into one passage, kept only with at least 5 passes; its difficulty = 1 − the product of (1 − difficulty of each slice). Boss phase: defeats in the phase ÷ attempts that reached the phase (at least 5). The ranking mixes every level and boss phase. "Practice this segment" opens segment practice from the previous checkpoint; "Practice this phase", boss practice on that phase.

strings.Comment c'est calculé : seuls comptent l: How it is computed: only complete segments count (from one checkpoint to the next, or to the finish) of campaign runs played from the start of a classic level (not EXTREME); no practice, no replay, no Invincible mode. The times come from the level's timer (the same as ghost racing). Sum of best (SOB) = the best time of each segment of your record's route, added up; time to gain = record − SOB. Time lost = median of the segment's last 50 times − its best time. Spread = interquartile range ÷ median. Regularity: standard deviation of the last 20 full runs, compared with that of the 20 runs before 30 days ago (more than 10% apart to call it a change). A new version of the level starts again from zero.

strings.Coopération et raids : l'âme d'un joueur: Co-op and raids: the soul of a downed player falls straight down to the ground under the point of death: killed in mid-jump, they wait right below. Over the void, a deadly liquid, spikes, ground too far down or a door, it goes to their last safe spot (firm ground, out of any liquid and danger, always reachable on foot): dead in magma, acid, on spikes, in the air or in the void, they can always be revived. The soul glides to its place, a mark on the ground shows where to revive, and an arrow points to it when it is off screen. If a liquid rises over the soul, it moves up above it. In a raid, a soul never waits in a passage or a door (it goes to the player's last safe spot, or to the nearest safe ground): reviving a player never takes the group to another zone.
strings.Coopération et raids : pour réanimer, ma: Co-op and raids: to revive, hold « Interact » for 2 s near the soul (the key shown is yours, keyboard or gamepad); letting go stops it. strings.Sous l'aurore éternelle de Glacior, des: Under the eternal aurora of Glacior, frost plains stretch to the frozen lake where the Cryowyrm lurks. Climb the ice cliffs with the triple jump and brave the blizzard.

strings.Sous la croûte des Confins dort une mer: Under the crust of the Confins sleeps a black sea. A little octopus was born there, with a single glow at the tip of one arm.
strings.Sous la croûte des Confins, une caverne: Under the crust of the Edge, a cave of rune-carved granite: the Monolithe and its eight phases, in a giant arena. One life, no checkpoint.

strings.Sous la glace, la lumière du cristal ne: Under the ice, the light of the crystal never fades.
strings.Sous les cendres de Pyralis, les forges: Under the ashes of Pyralis, the forges of the Ancients are slowly sinking into the lava. Learn the Seismic Slam, break the cracked floors and silence the Hammer of the Depths.
Under Les Confins sleep catacombs. Old Ossian lit a candle there for each of the dead.
Under Les Confins roared a foundry. A thousand workers cast the steel of the system's ships there.
strings.Sous les Confins, des catacombes de verr: Under Les Confins, catacombs of black glass where soul candles burn: the Lich of the Catacombs and her eight phases, in a giant arena. One life, no checkpoint.
strings.Sous les Confins, une fonderie engloutie: Under Les Confins, a swallowed foundry whose fires were never put out: the Mechanical Titan and its eight phases, in a giant arena. One life, no checkpoint.
strings.Sous les plaines gelées s'ouvrent des gr: Beneath the frozen plains lie flooded crystal caves. Swim, climb the shafts with the grapple and face the Frost Hydra that guards the depths.
strings.Sous les ruines dort une machine colossa: Below the ruins sleeps a colossal machine... The signal comes from its heart.
strings.Sous les ruines suspendues dort une mach: Below the hanging ruins sleeps a colossal machine. Go down into its halls of metal and crystal, master the Grapple and shut down the Prime Sentinel that guards its heart.
strings.Sous les ruines suspendues, la machineri: Below the hanging ruins, the machinery of the Ancients is still beating: rhythmic lasers, doors racing against time, levers and anchors above the acid. The Archon keeps watch.
strings.Sous les ruines, la canopée géante de Sy: Below the ruins, the giant canopy of Sylvanox breathes clouds of spores above the abyss. Learn to glide on its updrafts and face the Spore Queen in her flooded chamber.
strings.Sous les ruines, la machine des Anciens: Below the ruins, the machine of the Ancients has never stopped beating.

strings.Appuie sur Saut pour bondir. Plus tu gar: Press Jump to leap. The longer you hold it, the higher Nova goes: a short tap for a step, a long press for the low wall. In the air, press it once more: double jump!
strings.Bonjour Nova, je suis Bip ! Pour marcher: Hello Nova, I'm Bip! To walk, use the direction keys or the left stick. Head right: the Star Nursery is waiting for you.
strings.Cette lanterne est un point de passage :: This lantern is a checkpoint: if Nova loses all her health, she starts again from here at once, with her powers. Here nothing is counted: neither the time nor the falls.
strings.Chut… ces petites bêtes dorment et ne te: Shh… these little creatures are asleep and won't hurt you. Get close and strike them: every blow makes them flash. Once all three are gone, the garden's gate opens.
strings.Didacticiel du premier lancement, « Le p: First-launch tutorial, "Nova's First Flight": at the very first launch of the game (no progression), Bip, a little robot companion, offers a test flight of about six minutes in the Star Nursery, a small gentle world outside the campaign (no planet on the map, no ranking, no record, nothing sent online). "Skip the tutorial" is offered at the start, with a confirmation.
strings.Fin du didacticiel : « Bravo, Nova ! » a: End of the tutorial: "Well done, Nova!" with what was learnt, the souvenir "First Flight" (a title of the Wardrobe, granted on this computer) and "Start the adventure", which opens Sylvanox. The tutorial is never replayed, whether it is finished or skipped; a player who already had a progression does not see it, and progression copies as well as account migration keep that choice.
Hop! Bip brings you back to solid ground.
It won't be offered again, not even later. The powers stay explained in the Power Guide (Pause menu): you can look at it at any time.
strings.Je suis Bip, ton petit robot. Avant la g: I'm Bip, your little robot. Before the great adventure, let me take you on a very gentle first flight, about six minutes long, to discover the game. Nothing in it is counted, and it is played only once.
strings.La gardienne câline est apaisée : tu es: The cuddly guardian is soothed: you're ready for the adventure.
strings.La Mère-Racine à moitié endormie : la ga: The Root Mother, half asleep: the tutorial's guardian, slow and considerate, who announces each of her attacks for a long time.
strings.La Pépinière d'étoiles : herbes rondes,: The Star Nursery: round grass, bouncing mushrooms and bubbles that carry Nova. Bip, a little robot, presents every novelty there before the adventure.
strings.La Ruée (le Dash) : file d'un coup, même: The Rush (the Dash): dart forward at once, even in the air.
strings.La tablette t'a donné la Ruée (le Dash): The tablet gave you the Rush (the Dash): Nova darts at once in the chosen direction, even in the air, and breaks crystal walls. It takes a little energy, which refills by itself.
strings.Le didacticiel ne se rejoue pas. Les pou: The tutorial can't be replayed. The powers stay explained in the Power Guide (Pause menu).
strings.Le jardin s'est rendormi : la porte s'ou: The garden has fallen back asleep: the gate opens.
strings.Le jeu est en pause tant que tu n'as pas: The game is paused until you've read this.
strings.Mycélia bâille… et boude un tout petit p: Mycelia yawns… and sulks just a tiny bit!
strings.Mycélia s'endort, toute contente : le ch: Mycelia falls asleep, all happy: the way opens!
strings.Neuf explications bloquantes : le jeu se: Nine blocking explanations: the game really pauses, a card shows Bip, a small animated preview, the text and the player's real keys (keyboard or Xbox / PlayStation gamepad); "Got it, let's go on" (Enter, A or a click) resumes the game.
strings.Part quand Nova se pose dessus, la porte: Sets off when Nova lands on it, carries her to the end of its route, then pops and is born again in its place.
strings.Pose-toi sur une bulle : elle t'emporte: Land on a bubble: it carries you over the stream. At the end of its route it pops: jump onto the bank before! If you fall, I'll bring you back to solid ground at once.
strings.Saute sur un champignon : il te renvoie: Jump on a mushroom: it sends you very high, all by itself. Use it to reach the ledge and the shards floating in the air!
strings.Sept zones : se déplacer, sauter (plus h: Seven zones: moving, jumping (higher by holding, double jump), bouncing on mushrooms and catching shards in the air, attacking sleepy little creatures that never strike back, taking the Rush (the Dash) from a tablet and crossing a stream on carrying bubbles, starting again from a lantern, then facing Cuddly Mycelia: the easiest boss of the game according to the bosses' difficulty rating, slowed down, with long-announced attacks. No fall is deadly: Bip brings Nova back to solid ground.
strings.Souvenir : le didacticiel « Le premier e: Souvenir: the tutorial "Nova's First Flight" finished
strings.Souvenir du didacticiel : le premier env: Souvenir of the tutorial: Nova's first flight, with Bip.
strings.Ton premier éclat ! Il y en a un peu par: Your first shard! They're scattered all around: pick them up as you go. Those floating very high are caught by bouncing. None of them is required.
strings.Une petite bête de la Pépinière d'étoile: A little creature of the Star Nursery, fast asleep: it never strikes back.
strings.Voici Mycélia, la gardienne câline ! Ava: Here is Mycelia, the cuddly guardian! Before each attack she gets ready for a long moment: that's your signal to jump or dart away with the Rush. Then strike her until her health bar is empty.
strings.Éditeur de niveaux : la « Bulle porteuse: Level editor: the "Carrying bubble" (a platform object that sets off when Nova lands on it, carries her to the end of its route, pops and is born again in its place) and the action "Tutorial: explanation card (pauses the game)".
strings.Pose-toi sur une bulle : elle t'emporte: Land on a bubble: it carries you over the stream, then pops at the end of its route and is born again in its place. If you fall, I'll bring you back to solid ground at once.
strings.Didacticiel : les bulles porteuses finis: Tutorial: carrier bubbles end above solid ground and the shard trail is at Nova's height; recoloured suits: the list received from the server is no longer replaced when it is unchanged.

strings.Chaque personnage joue ses animations im: Every character plays its animations frame by frame (hatching, fire breath, cloud of smoke, coughing, swallowed embers, transformation, roar), and the scenery is alive too: twinkling stars, drifting clouds and mist, magma breathing at the foot of the spires, embers crackling on the ground, ash blown by the wind, glows and shadows following the fire. The layers scroll at their own speed, the camera follows the action, the screen shakes and lights up in time with the text, which stays as long to read as before.
strings.L'histoire de Pyrrhax, « Le Dragon d'Obs: The story of Pyrrhax, “The Obsidian Dragon”, becomes a short cartoon: its six shots are animated scenes made of real sprites in the game's style — Smoky and his fire brothers and sisters, the egg hatching in the nest of ashes, the flames, the smoke, the rain of embers, the belly lighting up, the change into a dragon of black glass, then the great Pyrrhax before the last frontier.

strings.Comment c'est calculé : seuls comptent l: How it is computed: only complete segments count (from one checkpoint to the next, or to the exit) of campaign runs played from the start of a classic level (not EXTREME), no training, no replay, no Invincible mode. Times come from the level timer (the same as ghost racing). Sum of Best (SOB) = the best time of each segment of your record's route, full runs and section training (same level version) together, added up; training only counts there: never in the record, the segment times nor the consistency. Time to gain = record − SOB. Time lost = median of the segment's last 50 times − its best time. Spread = interquartile range ÷ median. Consistency: standard deviation of the last 20 full runs, compared with the 20 runs before 30 days ago (more than a 10 % difference to call it a change). A new version of the level starts from zero.
strings.Entraînement par segment › « Regarder »: Section training › “Watch”: your best segments one after the other, each played back exactly from the replay of the run or training attempt that set it; at each cut, “Segment 2 · training on 17/11 · 0:23.45” or “run on 12/11”, and a timer that adds up to the sum of best, compared with the record. Play, pause, previous / next segment, speed, with keyboard, gamepad and mouse.
strings.Fin de course › Segments, en ligne : une: End of run › Segments, online: a “World record · name” column with the splits of the verified world record of the same level version (read from its verified replay, never a pending record), duration and cumulative gap; “loading…” during the request, no column offline; if it was already a ghost of the run, its column is renamed.
strings.Les replays des meilleurs segments reste: The best segments' replays stay on this computer (never sent, nothing ranked) as long as a best segment refers to them. A best time set before this version has no replay — unless it comes from your record, the previous one or your last run, found at the exact time: the montage says so instead of inventing it.

The record, the segment times and the consistency stay those of full runs.
Its time is added to the timer.

It waits for Nova as she left it (same wave, defeated enemies stay defeated, the others stay where they are with their health); its doors open to let her back in and close behind her. strings.L'histoire du Monolithe, « Le Golem Prim: The Monolith's story, “The Primordial Golem”, becomes a little cartoon too: the pebble tumbling in the dust of the beginning, the children of the cave carving their rune on it, the stone growing generation after generation before it stands up, the village and its fire, the ships leaving for the stars, then the golem alone in the ruins facing a visitor it does not recognise. Living scenery (breathing crystals, torches, mist, dust), characters animated frame by frame, a camera that follows the action; a NEW pill leads to “Watch the story again”.
strings.L'histoire du Kraken, « La Lanterne des: The Kraken's story, “The Lantern of the depths”, becomes a little cartoon too: the egg hatching in the black sea under the crust of the Confins, the little octopus with one lit arm, the lost fish following its light to the hot springs, the star's light falling into the sea in sparks, its eight arms lighting up one by one, the fish fleeing from its shadow into the cracks, then the Kraken waiting at the bottom of the Trench. Living scenery (rays of light, drifting silt, swaying kelp, jellyfish, glowing reefs), characters animated frame by frame; a NEW pill leads to “Watch the story again”.

strings.L'histoire du Phénix, « Le Porteur d'aub: The Phoenix's story, “The Dawn Bearer”, becomes a little cartoon too: the little bird of light leaving the star of the centre, its flight over the sleeping volcanoes and the valleys of black glass where day breaks behind it, the long night it waits through on its crag, its feathers catching fire until it falls into ashes, its rebirth bigger and brighter, then the Phoenix burning itself away in its nest on the peak. Living scenery (dawn breaking, smoking volcanoes, glittering glass, mist), characters animated frame by frame; a NEW pill leads to “Watch the story again”.
strings.L'histoire de la Liche, « Le Gardien des: The Lich's story, “The Keeper of Names”, becomes a little cartoon too: old Ossian lighting a candle for each of the dead of the catacombs, the stones whose names light up as he tells them to a child, the night the star collapses and the living flee while he stays, his soul hidden in the crystal on the altar, the centuries putting out the candles and leaving only his bones and the green flame, then the Lich watching over its crypt among the names. Living scenery (niches, candles, cobwebs, mist, dust), characters animated frame by frame; a NEW pill leads to “Watch the story again”.
strings.L'histoire du Titan, « Le Dernier Quart: The Titan's story, “The Last Shift”, becomes a little cartoon too: the foundry under the Confins with its furnaces, the crucible pouring steel and the workers hammering, the colossus waking up on its scaffold, the foreman entrusting it with the fires on the night the star collapses, the rock swallowing the foundry while it tends the fires alone, the rust and the steam, then the Titan turning on the visitor come to “put out its fires”. Living scenery (roaring furnaces, gears, chains, smoke, sparks), characters animated frame by frame; a NEW pill leads to “Watch the story again”.
strings.Petits textes (fenêtre 1280×720 et moins: Small texts (1280×720 windows and smaller): the spaces between words no longer disappear.
strings.L'histoire de Singularis, « Le Cœur effo: Singularis's story, “The Collapsed Heart”, becomes a little cartoon too: Lyse, the very young star at the centre of Kepler-Voss, her song of light with three little planets turning round her, her gifts (sap, fire, the glitter of ice) making them bloom, the machines come to drink her light, the last spark shivering with cold, then the collapse and Singularis waking up hungry, pulling everything in. Living space (a turning nebula, twinkling stars, veils of dust, debris), characters animated frame by frame; a NEW pill leads to “Watch the story again”.

strings.Asterion en vrai pixel art : dans CLANS: Asterion in real pixel art: in CLANS › RAIDS and on an event's sheet, the titan is now a detailed sprite, part by part (Skullmaw skull, Dreadfang and Pyroclast arms, Heartbreaker torso, Voidworm abdomen, Graviton and Titanus legs, cosmic heart, aura) that breathes, whose heart beats and around which particles drift. Hover a part with the mouse or reach it with the keyboard or the gamepad: it lights up and its tooltip gives its name, its gigaboss, its state (under attack, weakened, destroyed or undiscovered) and what destroying it does to Asterion.

strings.La carte globale du titan : la fiche d'u: The global map of the titan: the sheet of a running raid opens « Titan map », the first of the three map levels. The whole Asterion with the state of its seven branches (not discovered yet, combat in progress, weakened), the groups fighting there (your clan in gold), the progress (zones controlled out of 56, objectives, gigabosses), the effects between branches, the reinforcements needed and the alerts of the whole titan. A branch (clicked on the titan or in the list, with the keyboard or the gamepad) opens its map of eight zones.
strings.Les branches sont liées : un objectif ac: The branches are linked: an objective completed in one acts on another, at the same moment for every player of an instance. The Skull's eyes put out switch off the Left arm's turrets, its severed nerves stop the Right leg's seismic wave, the Left leg's generators cut make the Torso's barriers fall, the Abdomen's nest destroyed removes its parasite reinforcements, the Right leg's reactors cut stop the Right arm's magma flows, and several ways only open when another branch gives way. The server only counts the objectives validated by the consensus of each instance.
strings.Raids de clan, phase 4 : tout le corps d: Clan raids, phase 4: Asterion's whole body is playable. Beside the Right arm, six new branches of eight zones each (56 zones in all), each with its own world, enemies, crossings and danger: Skullmaw's SKULL (floating vertebrae, laser gazes, psychic wave), Dreadfang's LEFT ARM (ice that gives way, turrets, claw sweep), Heartbreaker's TORSO (moving ribs, energy barriers, heart pulse, four plates to break with several groups), Voidworm's ABDOMEN (acid pools, parasite nest, acid reflux), Graviton's LEFT LEG (weightless wells, shifting islets, gravity wells) and Titanus' RIGHT LEG (giant pistons, lava, seismic wave). Each branch has two paths, a secret zone and its relic, a shortcut to open with a lever, a zone that needs two groups and a lock of several objectives; each gigaboss' door stays sealed until the next version.
strings.Répartition des joueurs : 8 joueurs au p: Player placement: 8 players at most per instance, up to 50 per clan. Choose a branch (or « Join where the clan needs me »): the server places you in a group of your clan that has room, opens a new one when all are full and sends latecomers where the clan is fighting. The « Clan placement » screen shows everyone's place; the chief, the officers and the raid leader move a player there or balance the groups of a branch.

strings.Le mini-film d'Asterion : la première fo: Asterion's mini-film: the first time you go to see the titan (CLANS › RAIDS, the sheet of an event), a cinematic of about two minutes tells who it is, in ten animated shots: the cosmic Heart beating alone in the void, its body forged from broken worlds, a planet devoured as its lights go out one by one, its seven parts and their Gigabosses revealed one by one (Skullmaw, Dreadfang, Pyroclast, Heartbreaker, Voidworm, Graviton, Titanus), our galaxy in its sights, Nova swept away by a backhand, the clans' beacons lighting up, the hologram of its branches to bring down, its roar and the title "ASTERION — THE DEVOURER OF WORLDS", then the call: "Gather your clan. The hunt begins." With its own music and sound effects. This first showing cannot be skipped; it only counts as seen once it has played to the end (closing the game halfway plays it again next time), and that follows you to another computer with your progression. The "Watch the cinematic again" button on the event's card plays it again whenever you like, and that one can be left.

strings.Combattre ensemble : tant que sa carapac: Fight together: while its carapace protects it, nothing hurts it. Its three vents spit jets of magma in turn; a player standing 3 s on a vent closes it, but a closed vent lights up again after 15 s: they must be held together. All three closed, the carapace bursts: its heart is bare (double damage) and its three weak points each break for a share of its health. Its health and the pace of its attacks follow the number of players in the instance (2 to 8). Reviving a downed ally counts as a rescue.
strings.Contributions calculées dans la simulati: Contributions computed in the simulation, the same on every computer of the instance: damage (and to the gigaboss), damage avoided (its blows dodged, the blows stopped by the shield), support, vents closed, weak points broken, objectives, participation time, presence at its fall. The server only keeps a table when the majority of the instance sent the same one, refuses impossible values and logs the liars; while it waits, the result is « awaiting validation ».

strings.Raids de clan, phase 4B : trois antres d: Clan raids, phase 4B: three of Asterion's lairs open. VOIDWORM, the worm of the void, waits at the bottom of the ABDOMEN; GRAVITON, the leg that bends space, at the end of the LEFT LEG; TITANUS, the leg that crushes everything, at the end of the RIGHT LEG. Three true raid fights in three announced phases, a last attack to survive, a look that changes at each phase, giants for eight players in arenas more than six screens wide.

strings.Voidworm surgit d'un gouffre au milieu d: Voidworm bursts out of a pit in the middle of its lair and cuts the group in two: it burrows under every player (a mark, then a maw bursting out of the ground), aims at players with a green ring and swallows those who stay in it — the others must burst its stomach to free them before it digests them. strings.La présentation du jeu (README) et sa do: The game's presentation (README) and its documentation now show the clan raids and co-op in short films recorded in the game: three players together on an EXTREME level, the fights against Pyroclast and Graviton, Asterion's appearance and the titan's map; every documentation page has its pictures and its “← Back” link.
strings.Attaque dirigée : maintenez Haut en atta: Aimed attack: hold Up while attacking to strike above Nova, on the ground as in the air; in the air, hold Down to strike below. On the ground, Down stays « crouch » (the attack then strikes forwards, as before) and, with the Seismic Slam, Down + Attack in the air stays the seismic slam. These strikes hit enemies (same damage, same knockback) and breakable objects like the forward strike, with their own animations and blade arc; a strike downwards in the air still bounces off the enemy it hits and gives back the air jumps, as before. The direction is the one chosen when the strike starts. Explained in Settings › Keyboard / mouse and Gamepad, and in the tutorial.
strings.Attaque vers le haut : Haut + Attaque, a: Attack upwards: Up + Attack, on the ground or in the air. Attack downwards: Down + Attack, in the air only (on the ground, Down stays « crouch »; with the Seismic Slam, Down + Attack in the air stays the slam).
strings.Chut… ces petites bêtes dorment et ne te: Shh… these little creatures are asleep and won't hurt you. Get close and strike them: every blow makes them flash. Once all three are gone, the garden's gate opens. With Up, you strike above you; in the air, with Down, below.
strings.Records et classements conservés : rien: Records and rankings kept: nothing is reset. Replays recorded before this version play back exactly as before (with the rules of their time); new replays note the version of the simulation that played them. Suits created online keep their sheet: during a strike upwards or downwards, Nova shows the forward strike in them.

strings.Raids de clan : consensus renforcé contr: Clan raids: a stronger consensus against cheating. Only the players really in play vote, a false report arriving at the same moment as the validation is refused and logged, nothing is accepted any more after a world event closes, and a group no longer moves back on the map when two reports arrive out of order.
strings.Raids de clan : relancer le jeu ou chang: Clan raids: restarting the game or changing networks in the middle of a fight no longer locks you out; your new connection takes your seat back.
strings.Raids de clan : testés à grande échelle: Clan raids: tested at a large scale (four clans of 50 players at once, a world event of 2,500 players): no registration, seat, reward or notification twice, and the server does the same work per request with 2 or 30 groups.
strings.Raids de clan : une instance ne s'arrête: Clan raids: an instance no longer stops when the whole group loses its connection at the same time; it waits 60 seconds for its players. It also survives a restart of the server relaying it: the game is saved every second and everyone finds it again on their return.
strings.Raids de clan, phase 7 : fiabilité. Si v: Clan raids, phase 7: reliability. If your link with the instance's relay drops, the game reconnects by itself during the 60 seconds your seat waits for you: the world stays shown under the « LINK LOST » card, then you rejoin your group after catching up, without going back through the branch map.

strings.La pastille en haut à droite des écrans: The pill at the top right of the COSMIC ONLINE screens now shows the real latency to the server: « Online - 25ms », measured on the game's light exchanges (presence heartbeat, connection check), smoothed over the last ones; « Online » alone until a first measure exists.
strings.Administration › Créations › Studio : un: Administration › Creations › Studio: a real editor to draw the creations' images. On the left the explorer (the server's suits, trails, frames and victory effects and this PC's drafts, search, new, duplicate, rename, archive, library); at the top the tabs of the open creations (• not saved, closing confirmed); in the middle the canvas, with zoom, grid, onion skin and coordinates, and its tools: pencil, eraser, paint bucket, eyedropper, line, rectangle, ellipse, selection, move, mirrors and symmetry, undo / redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y); on the right the palette (the creation's, Nova's, the planets'), the HSV picker, the #rrggbb code and the live preview.
strings.Bras droit : le magma monte plus souvent: Right arm: the magma rises more often (every 34 s in the Magma vein, 42 s in the Forge elbow, and now 38 s in the Forearm, with ledges to shelter on), announced 4 s before. Pyroclast's pits and lava curtains use this new magma too.
strings.Chronomètre en raid (vrais raids et test: Timer in raids (real raids and the admin test): the same timer as in the levels, counted on the simulation's steps (the same for the whole group), with the time since the instance began and, under it, the time spent in the zone. It keeps running during a player's pause (the world never stops); it is an element of the HUD editor's “Raids” layout (movable, resizable, can be hidden).

strings.Coopération sur un même PC : un périphér: Co-op on one PC: one device per player. The keyboard and the mouse go together to one player only, each gamepad to one player only; Start or A on a free gamepad takes a place, B leaves it, "Change device" moves to the next free one, and the gamepad given a place rumbles once. Each card of the lobby shows its player's device ("Xbox gamepad (no. 1)", the number kept when it is plugged back in) and lights up the buttons being pressed; the list of connected devices updates live (an unplugged gamepad stays there for a few seconds). Xbox, PlayStation, Switch (B at the bottom, A on the right, ZL / ZR, + / −) or generic glyphs.

They are replaced by signs the game's fonts have (“OK”, “+”, “◊”, “■”, “◀▶”, “–”); a test now checks that every text of the game, in French and in English, only uses characters its fonts have.

strings.Magma des raids : les montées de magma s: Raid magma: the magma rises are now realistic. The magma rises from the bottom and drains away, drawn over the players and the monsters: nothing shows through it any more, only a glow at its surface above what it hides. Enemies caught in the magma burn like a player would (bosses excepted). New animated lava: a molten body that flows, a dark crust that drifts, bright waves, bubbles that pop, embers, heat, and an alert before each rise (the level it will reach, the ground cracking).
strings.Manette débranchée en pleine partie (en: Gamepad unplugged in the middle of a game (alone as in co-op on one PC): the game and the timer pause and "GAMEPAD UNPLUGGED" says whose it was; plugging it back in restarts the game after 3, 2, 1. A on another free gamepad takes the player's place with their keys, Enter gives them the keyboard if it is free; in co-op, "Continue without…" lets the team go on without them (60 s to come back, as online). Online, the 60-second reconnection rule does not change. A gamepad's low battery: a line in the team panel, no pause.
strings.Minimap des raids refaite en textures :: The raid minimap redone in textures: readable rock and ledges, lava, the area the magma floods, open or locked passages, doors, objectives (to do, done, optional), checkpoints, group plates, vents, enemies, bosses, allies in their colour and you in gold, with a small measured legend.

strings.Raids de clan : une zone garde ce que le: Clan raids: a zone keeps what the group did in it. Coming back to a zone (or when the whole group falls and the zone starts again), the doors and passages opened, the levers, the generators, the arenas and ambushes cleared, the guardians and enemies beaten, the relics taken, the group plates and the last checkpoint stay as you left them. What another group validated applies too (a guardian it beat is no longer there).
strings.Test admin « Tester Asterion » : il se j: Admin test “Test Asterion”: it plays like a real instance. The branch's state carries from one zone to the next (as the server sends it in a raid), and the simulated players are real, visible companions named “Simulated player 2”, “Simulated player 3”… with their colour in the group panel: they follow you, jump the gaps, strike the nearby enemies, stand on the plates, the lifts and the vents with you, revive the players down and flee the magma. The mechanisms for several players therefore work alone. A test still sends nothing to the server.

strings.Être présent à la chute du Cœur d'Asteri: Be present at the fall of Asterion's Heart, the final fight of a clan raid (reward claimed in CLANS › RAIDS).
strings.Ses artères se gonflent de lumière : ten: Its arteries swell with light: hold the four arteries together to bare its ventricles!
strings.Raids de clan, phase 6 : LE CŒUR D'ASTER: Clan raids, phase 6: ASTERION'S HEART, the final fight. Once the seven gigaboss have fallen (validated by the server), the titan's heart opens on the titan's map and every group of every clan can fight it at the same time: a long Cosmic aorta for eight (giant ambushes over three floors, locks, a goods lift, checkpoints), then a gigantic arena nine screens wide, its shuttles and ferries turning around a captive star bigger than a screen.
strings.Sa vie est partagée : chaque instance jo: Its health is shared: each instance plays its own run, but what it tears from the Heart (validated by the consensus of its players) adds up on the server with what every other one took, and each group sees the others' part taken from it at the same moment on all its screens. It falls for everyone when its shared health is gone: the victory is validated by the server, once, even if two groups strike the last blow together.
strings.Quatre phases : « Le cœur qui bat », « L: Four phases: “The beating heart”, “The arteries” (hold its four arteries together, two on the floor at the walls and two on high balconies, to bare its three ventricles), “The crown of stars” (a plasma tide burns the floor: stay on the platforms) and a very hard last phase, “Supernova”: at each charge, enough players must hold the anchors at once to contain it, or the whole arena burns.
strings.Ses lances stellaires visent les huit jo: Its star lances aim at all eight players at once, its charges cross whole storeys. What the seven branches destroyed really acts on it: the Skull fallen, its lances lose their precision; the Left arm, no more sweeps; the Right arm, no more magma rain; the Torso, no more cage around the heart; the Abdomen, no more spawn; the Left leg, no more gravity traps; the Right leg, its charges slow down. Each relic of the secret zones validated weakens it further. The HUD shows its shared health, its phase, your group's part and the others', and a summary of the branches' effects at the arena's door.
strings.Victoire : le film « La chute d'Asterion: Victory: the film “The fall of Asterion” (the titan collapses, its heart becomes a supernova, the clans' banners rise) starts for the whole group as soon as the server validates the fall, then can be watched again from the event's sheet (“Watch the victory again”).
strings.Récompenses, chacune accordée une seule: Rewards, each granted once by the server: the “Asterion's Heart” badge (present at its fall), the “Asterion's Supernova” victory effect (one minute of validated fight in its arena), the “Asterion's Heart” profile frame for the 10 best contribution scores of the event (the mixed score, never the damage alone) and the collective clan title “Star Breakers” for each clan present at the fall. The world event only announces “Asterion has fallen” with the seven gigaboss AND the heart; registered players are told when the heart opens and when it falls.

strings.Fiches d'Asterion : le schéma « Où frapp: Asterion's sheets: the « Where to hit » diagram now shows each attack on its real animation. Under the phases and states, pick a pose (« At rest » or an attack of the phase): the Gigaboss plays its wind-up then its blow, and the diagram shows what comes out of it (red: what hurts, such as the rush, the impact and its shockwaves, the crown of flames; pink: where its shots and beams come from).
strings.Fiches d'Asterion : les points faibles e: Asterion's sheets: the weak points and targets are drawn with their own sprite, where the fight sticks them (Skullmaw's eyes and crystal, Pyroclast's knuckles, Titanus's knee and restraints…); a cross marks the Gigaboss's feet, where everything is measured from. Fix: Heartbreaker's four plates are the armour of its first phase (the diagram showed them in phase 2).
strings.Raids : les tirs et rayons des Gigaboss: Raids: the Gigaboss's shots and beams finally leave their drawing, no longer 80 to 300 px above them: Skullmaw's gaze, Pyroclast's bombs, Heartbreaker's clots, the Voidworm's spit, the beam of Asterion's Heart. The crown of flames of Heartbreaker, Graviton and the Heart keeps its radius (it circled much further out). Other enemies do not change and no record is erased.
strings.Raids : les règles des Gigaboss changent: Raids: the Gigaboss rules change (shots and crown), so a raid instance only brings together players on 2.75.2 or later: update the game to join your group.
strings.4 nouveaux pouvoirs (Ralenti temporel, B: 4 new powers (Time Slow, Plasma Bomb, Magnet, Air Dash), animated power guide, bosses that keep their wounds, progress bar without a frame.
strings.72 nouveaux succès (218, 597 étoiles) et: 72 new achievements (218, 597 stars) and 22 new rewards in the Collection. Fixed: changing a key no longer triggers another action. Keys shown according to your keyboard (AZERTY / QWERTY).
strings.Administration › Créations : traînées, c: Administration › Creations: trails, avatar frames and victory effects created by an admin, given as challenge rewards; ghosts with a trail; victory effect visible right at the exit; "all levels" achievement at 25 levels.
strings.Alerte de mise à jour dans le menu princ: Update alert in the main menu (verified download, then installation), "Keys…" before a challenge, uniform ONLINE RANKING buttons.
strings.Badges du profil : 2 succès dès 100 étoi: Profile badges: 2 achievements from 100 stars, 3 from 250, chosen in the Collection.
strings.Barre de progression, notifications du m: Progress bar, menu notifications (lost records, what's new, new installer), look of the bosses.
strings.Barres de défilement saisissables à la s: Scroll bars you can grab with the mouse, everywhere.

strings.Collection : récompenses visuelles déblo: Collection: visual rewards unlocked by achievement stars (suits, trails, frames, titles, victory effects), jukebox of the music heard, gallery of planets and creatures. Advanced replay player and comparison of two replays with an offset. "No damage" fix; Ctrl+A/C/X/V in text fields.
strings.Collection en ligne : le cadre d'avatar: Online Collection: your equipped avatar frame and title follow you in the rankings and on your public profile, which also shows your outfit. Ghosts wear their player's suit. A private profile shows none of this.
strings.Correction du faux « NOUVEAU RECORD ! »: Fixed the false "NEW RECORD!" after a revision; a revision without a major change keeps your record and the rankings; no more pink checkerboard for Les Confins (boss statistics, jukebox, gallery).
strings.Créations : combinaisons recolorées créé: Creations: recoloured suits created by an admin, won in challenges.
strings.Didacticiel du premier lancement « Le pr: First-launch tutorial "Nova's First Flight"; Invincible (admin) on the segment practice screen.
strings.Discussion dans l'éditeur en direct (mes: Chat in the live editor (messages kept, replies), PROJECTS refreshed on its own with counters, map of the explored areas in the pause menu, and display fixes.
strings.Défi en cours modifiable par un administ: The current challenge can be edited by an administrator (while no result is recorded); bronze / silver / gold medals on each challenge of the calendar.
strings.Défis de la semaine et du mois, calendri: Weekly and monthly challenges, calendar and past challenges after the deadline, "Furthest" ranking, friends' presence, avatars that open the profile.
strings.Défis du jour : un niveau par jour (camp: Daily challenges: one level a day (campaign or ONLINE LEVELS, chosen by the administrator) with its rules and three tiers, daily ranking of verified times, streak, archives. Playable without an account and offline.
strings.Entités natives en lecture seule dans l': Native entities read-only in the Workshop, editable by an admin with the choice of records level by level.
strings.Entraînement contre les boss : cœurs, em: Boss practice: hearts, slots and powers of your choice, all phases or only one, in the boss's real level. Practice never counts (achievements, statistics, records, progression).
strings.Entraînement par segment (aperçu, PB, Su: Segment practice (preview, PB, Sum of Best, choice of powers), mouse buttons in the key bindings, "Record beaten" notification.
strings.Fiche de chaque boss (PV, phases, attaqu: Sheet of each boss (HP, phases, attacks, weaknesses) and difficulty from 1 to 10 stars.
strings.Ghost Racing : courez contre vos meilleu: Ghost Racing: race against your best times, your latest runs, the world records and your friends' records, with live gaps, segments and practice mode. 134 achievements on a web, focus mode (T key) and adjustable level messages.
strings.Histoire des giga-boss (cinématiques ill: Story of the giga-bosses (illustrated cutscenes before the first fight); migrate to a new account; Charged Boomerang achievements; admins' Invincible mode in practice; game version in Administration › Players.
strings.La Liche des Catacombes : « La Crypte de: The Lich of the Catacombs: "The Crypt of Names" (EXTREME, Les Confins), its altars, its baleful runes, its hex and its phylactery; its story, its achievements, its Wardrobe and its music.
strings.Langue du jeu : français ou anglais, au: Game language: French or English, chosen in the Windows installer; change it at any time in Settings › Game › "Langue / Language". The whole game is translated; the players' content stays as its authors wrote it.
strings.Le HUD s'efface quand il cache le boss,: The HUD fades when it hides the boss, Nova or an attack (adjustable in Settings › Game).
strings.Le Kraken des Abysses : « La Fosse des A: The Kraken of the Abyss: "The Abyssal Trench" (EXTREME, Les Confins), its illustrated story, its achievements, its Wardrobe and its music.
strings.Le Phénix Stellaire : « Le Nid de Cendre: The Stellar Phoenix: "The Nest of Ashes" (EXTREME, Les Confins), it rises from its ashes; its story, its achievements, its Wardrobe and its music.
strings.Le Titan Mécanique : « La Fonderie Englo: The Mechanical Titan: "The Swallowed Foundry" (EXTREME, Les Confins), its hydraulic presses, its lock-on missiles, its conveyor belts, its overheating and its stalling; its story, its achievements, its Wardrobe and its music.
strings.Les Confins : « Le Cœur de Pierre » et l: Les Confins: "The Heart of Stone" and the Monolith, a giant eight-phase boss; the levels of Les Confins are the boss fight alone; NEW badges on everything Les Confins brings; the golem's music in the jukebox.
strings.Monolithe réveillé (Carapace roulante, T: Monolith awakened (Rolling Shell, Earthquake, Titanic Leap; records kept); arrows towards off-screen enemies; achievement suggestions and tracking; Enemies defeated HUD.
strings.Niveaux EXTRÊME (une seule vie) et cours: EXTREME levels (a single life) and verification race: each attempt is ranked by its progress, the first to finish verifies the level. EXTREME option in the editor, publishing without a level end.
strings.Notez les niveaux de la campagne de 1 à: Rate the campaign levels from 1 to 5 stars: the players' average is shown in the campaign and in ONLINE. Reviews and comments on the official levels in ONLINE. Comments on the runs of the rankings, with replies and reactions.
strings.Nouvelle planète Aethra (4 niveaux) et s: New planet Aethra (4 levels) and its four guardians: Mycelia, Aurorax, Pyrogyre, Nyxara, with 12 new attacks. Four new powers: boomerang blade, frost nova, decoy, recall beacon. The Echo Arena now chains the 16 guardians. New achievements and guardian statistics.
strings.Nouvelle planète Les Confins, ouverte dè: New planet Les Confins, open from the start; "The Dragon's Maw" (EXTREME) and Pyrrhax, the Obsidian Dragon, a giant eight-phase boss; achievements and Wardrobe rewards; retry in practice after a fall in EXTREME.
strings.Noyau stellaire : l'Arène des Échos (les: Stellar Core: the Echo Arena (the 12 guardians, no healing, a single life) and the final level, the Heart of the Star, against the Astrarch.
strings.Pastilles « NOUVEAU » sur tout le chemin: "NEW" badges all the way to each new feature, even deep down; a parent button's badge stays as long as there is something new below it.
strings.Pause : Succès suivis sous la carte (cin: Pause: tracked achievements under the map (five places, descriptions); keys shared between levels with identical keys; Invincible (admin) not ranked.
strings.Points des pays bien visibles sur le glo: Clearly visible country dots on the rankings globe. SOCIAL: a globe of all players by country. Unread message counters on SOCIAL, on "Online" and on each conversation or group.
strings.Projets : historique filtrable, comparai: Projects: filterable history, comparison, restoring and named versions; grouped notifications in live editing; more robust against disconnections and surges.
strings.Projets collaboratifs : des niveaux cons: Collaborative projects: levels built together with roles checked by the server, invitations by key or cosmic:// link, membership requests and revisions that never overwrite each other.
strings.Présence des amis dans les discussions p: Friends' presence in private chats and in a friend's profile.
strings.Pyrrhax déchaîné (piqué, atterrissage, b: Pyrrhax unleashed (dive, landing, cloud fireballs, wing gust); new power: the Charged Boomerang; every power in the giga-boss arenas, without resetting any ranking; clearer level keys.
strings.Rayons des boss texturés (flamme, givre,: Textured boss beams (flame, frost, plasma, sap, starlight) with a single beam per attack; level rules (damage factor, number of lives) shown and adjustable in the editor.
strings.Regarder un ami jouer en direct (amis ac: Watch a friend play live (accepted friends only, without notification).
strings.Replay de chaque joueur classé (CLASSEME: Replay of every ranked player (ONLINE RANKING, ONLINE LEVELS, EXTREME race), "Best progressions" profile with search and filters, EXTREME frame that warns.
strings.Replays recadrés dans la place libre, bo: Replays framed in the free space, "Hide info" button (I, Select), A / B names never on the HUD again.
strings.Replays téléchargés (hors ligne) ; campa: Downloaded replays (offline); campaign editable by an admin.
strings.Récompenses des défis : cinq cosmétiques: Challenge rewards: five cosmetics won by verified runs, as icons with a tooltip.
strings.Récompenses par défi et titres créés par: Rewards per challenge and titles created by an admin; Backups tab.
strings.S'accroupir sur place, caméra sur toute: Crouch in place, camera over the whole boss arena, arrow towards an off-screen boss, boss statistics (phases without damage), energy costs according to the strength of the powers and power sheet. New ranking generation.
strings.Sauvegardes complètes : plus de délai dé: Full backups: no more timeouts, real progress bar.
strings.Singularis, le Cœur Effondré : gardien à: Singularis, the Collapsed Heart: an eight-phase guardian, and the EXTREME level "The Heart of a Dying Star".
strings.Statistiques des boss : chaque boss s'an: Boss statistics: each boss moves with its real animations, and "Where to fight it" lists every place to fight it (campaign level and echo in The Echo Arena).
strings.Touches des pouvoirs par emplacement : P: Power keys per slot: Power 1 to 8, set in Settings › Keyboard / mouse and Controller. Golden dotted frame for the powers that do not use their slot's key. "NEW" badge on new features. Old replays and records still valid.
strings.Touches des pouvoirs par niveau (éditeur: Power keys per level (editor, level select, pause), back to the same segment after practice, the level's boss in the level select, aligned "Focus mode".
strings.Un compte, un ordinateur ; local et en l: One account, one computer; local and online with "Back online"; online copy of the progression; the verification race kept with "Keep the records"; hidden presence; timer independent of the intro.
strings.Une seule touche par commande, en une co: A single key per command, in one column, and a "Default" button on each line of the key settings.
strings.Version française entièrement en françai: French version entirely in French (NIVEAUX EN LIGNE, CLASSEMENTS, ATELIER, VOIR LE REPLAY, ENVOYER LE RECORD…). Fixed: "Back" in the Collection closed the game. Comparison replay: A and B on the level's progress bar.
strings.Vos statistiques voyagent avec la copie: Your statistics travel with the progression copy and the account migration, merged without counting twice.
strings.Workshop en ligne : favoris, commentaire: Online Workshop: favourites, comments with replies and reactions, creator profiles with followers and creations, Cosmic Online notification centre, time played in hours and minutes (levels and profiles).
strings.« Le Cœur d'une Étoile Mourante » devien: "The Heart of a Dying Star" becomes the fight against Singularis alone; the boss's NEW badges.

strings.Éditeur de niveaux refait en panneaux fi: Level editor rebuilt with fixed panels: explorer, library with categories and favourites, entity sheet with its relations, link, zone and collision overlays, multiple selection table.

strings.Édition en direct des projets : présence: Live editing of projects: members' presence (cursors, selections, activity), temporary locks, operations synchronised and kept offline, visible refusals in case of conflict.

strings.Pyrrhax se bat par parties : sa tête est: Pyrrhax fights by parts: its head is a weak point (× 2), its tail is armoured (× 0.5), its neck, body, wings and legs take the hits normally. strings.Ennemis qui fuient : un ennemi affaibli: Fleeing enemies: a weakened enemy no longer goes further than 5.5 tiles from where it started fleeing, and a flying enemy no longer rises more than 2 tiles above it. strings.Éditeur d'ennemis : un onglet Boss › « P: Enemy editor: a tab Boss › « Parts (where to hit) » shows a boss's parts on its sprite, with the pose and the frame of your choice. For each part it sets its role (weak point, normal, armoured, hurts), its damage multiplier and the attacks during which it also hurts. Choose a part by clicking it or in the list, with the keyboard or the gamepad.
strings.Gigaboss de la campagne : Singularis, le: Campaign Gigaboss: Singularis, the Monolith, the Phoenix, the Lich, the Mechanical Titan, the Kraken and the Astrarch fight by parts, like Pyrrhax. Their head, eyes, reactor or phylactery are weak points (× 2), their shell, carapace, rings, armour plate, tail or train are armoured (× 0.5), the rest takes the hits normally, and you can hit them far beyond their old box. Earlier replays play again exactly and no record is erased.
strings.Ce qui blesse au contact : les épines et: What hurts on contact: Singularis's spines and corona of fire (its shell too during its fall), the Monolith's fists during its slams and quakes, the Phoenix's talons, the soul flames of the Lich's train, the Titan's chimneys (its fist during its punch), the Kraken's beak (its tentacles during its lashes and its embrace), the Astrarch's crucibles and spikes (its hull and plates during its rushes). The rest of their body no longer hurts.
strings.Leurs mécanismes ne changent pas : le Mo: Their mechanics do not change: the Monolith curled into a ball stays armoured and is exposed when dizzy, the Phoenix cannot be hurt in its ashes, nor the Lich while its soul is in the crystal on the altar, nor the stalled Titan until its valves are turned, and its bare reactor takes even more.
strings.Tirs des gigaboss : ils partent de leur: Gigaboss shots: they leave their drawing (Singularis's eye and hands, the Lich's crystal, the beak of the Phoenix and of the Kraken, the Titan's cannon). The Astrarch now throws the breath and the bolts it borrows from its heart and its arm, no longer from the empty air above it.
strings.Boss classiques : les 16 gardiens des pl: Classic bosses: the 16 guardians of the planets and of Aethra, and the tutorial's Cuddly Mycelia, fight by parts, like Pyrrhax. Their parts follow their drawing frame by frame: a raised arm, a falling sword, a diving dragon head are hit where you see them.
strings.Où frapper : la tête, les yeux et le cœu: Where to hit: the head, the eyes and the exposed heart are weak points (× 2); shells, pauldrons, rings, cap and tails are armoured (× 0.5); the rest takes blows normally. Thorns, spikes, flames, weapons, tentacles and thrusters hurt on contact, and each attack makes its own parts hurt: the striking fist or arm, the diving maw, the biting heads.
strings.Les tirs et les rayons des boss classiqu: The shots and beams of the classic bosses leave their drawing: the fist of the Thornwarden and of the Archon, their heart for the beam, Aurorax's lance, Mycelia's cap, Nyxara's eyes, Pyrogyre's eye, the hammer of the Crucible Heart.
strings.Les 16 échos du Noyau stellaire se batte: The 16 echoes of the Stellar Core fight like their original, with the same parts. Earlier replays play again with the box, exactly, and no record is erased.

Health by group size, from 2 to 8 players, with the real scaling. For each phase: its threshold in % and in HP, and its states (armoured, bare…). The damage of its contact and of each blow, in hearts. The multipliers of each part (weak point × 2, armoured × 0.5), speed, size, time limit and pace by group size.
